widgets_values: If you have a 30XX card like I do, I highly recommend using int8 convrot version of the model. It's 2x faster than using fp8/GGUF for 30XX cards. Either way, enter the subgraph below if you need to swap to GGUF or int8 loader nodes.

nodes.title: Start!
widgets_values: Make sure to disable Finish Mode if you're starting from scratch and just want to seed hunt in stage 1. When you're ready to gen, always click Manual Random Seed below to get a fresh batch of 4 low res gens to choose from.
Sampler previews. Get the taeltx2_3.pth file from https://github.com/madebyollin/taehv/tree/main

Reroll Stage 2 and Stage 3 as many times as you like by clicking the Manual Random Seed buttons below, provided you don't change anything that would affect stage 1 latents, such as changing the prompt, vid length, resolution, etc. Otherwise, it'll force comfyUI to regen Stage 1 all over again.

Lora loading is separated out between stage 1, and stage 2/3. Meaning, stage 1 can use different loras at different strengths than stage 2/3. This offers finer control, but also means that if you want to just use a lora for all stages, you have to select it below and in the lora loader to the right.

I highly recommend if there's one lora you use, it's OmniNFL-RL, which improves the look and motion of shots.
https://huggingface.co/Kijai/LTX2.3_comfy/blob/main/loras/LTX-2.3-OmniNFT-RL-Lora_bf16.safetensors

Note: The 4 sample gens will process in a random order thanks to how comfyUI works. I couldn't control it to get it to gen 1, 2, 3, and then 4. Anyway, when they're done, use the slider below to select which latent you like, then toggle Finish Mode on, and click "Manual Random Seed" to the right on the "Start Stage 2" node.

each stage has a customizable sampler option!
euler_ancestral_cfg_pp is 2x slower than euler_ancestral, but it does yield better motion.
You CAN mix and match if you want faster gen times. Experiment!
